exceptions.reason: Development-only Astro ESLint parser. The affected glob patterns come from trusted parserOptions.project configuration, not article contents or visitor input. This repository does not set parserOptions.project. No fixed release is published.
exceptions.removeWhen: A fixed braces release or a compatible Astro ESLint parser without fast-glob is available.

exceptions.reason: Development-only dependency of the js-yaml command-line interface. LHCI imports the YAML library; it does not run that CLI. The repository uses a CommonJS Lighthouse configuration. No untrusted format string reaches sprintf-js on this path and no fixed release is published.
exceptions.removeWhen: A fixed sprintf-js release or an LHCI update removing the js-yaml 3 CLI dependency is available.
